title: fix(runtime)!: the automation write doors refuse a notify node naming a channel no plugin registers (#32142)
body:
Fixes #32142

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — every `notify` node `skills/objectstack-automation` teaches names `inbox` or `email`, which the messaging service registers, and the refusal text carries the cure.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** `/automation` 的三个流程保存门(`POST /`、`PUT /:name`、复制门 `POST /:name/clone`)在保存时检查 `notify` 节点的 `channels`:写了一个没有任何插件注册的渠道(如把 `email` 写成 `emial`),当场回 400,点名节点与渠道，并列出本部署已注册的渠道作为修法;岗位与队列保存时不查，文档写明它们运行时才判。
- **为什么改:** 维护者裁决 B(6810493176)。以前这种流程照常保存并启用，每次运行到该节点都投递失败，作者(尤其通过 API 写流程的 AI)毫不知情。
- **风险与回滚:** 只在保存门、只在内核 `kernel:ready` 之后、只在有消息服务时判;启动时注册的打包流程和已存储的流程不受影响。回滚即撤销本 PR(单个函数加一次调用)。
- **先看:** `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` 的 `refuseUnknownNotifyChannels`(判定条件三条)及其在 `registerAndSaveFlow` 中的调用;`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-authoring-doors-durable.test.ts` 末尾新 describe;`content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` 新段落。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/automation-authoring-doors-durable.test.ts`,预期 16 条全过;或在本地 showcase 用管理员 `POST /api/v1/automation` 提交 `channels: 'emial'` 的 notify 流程，预期 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`,消息含 `did you mean 'email'?` 与已注册渠道清单。
- **需要你做的:** 无，席位落地(收窄欠一次契约复审档复核，由席位执行)。

## What changes

`registerAndSaveFlow` (the one persistence path of the three `/automation` definition write doors) now asks one more question after the engine has accepted a definition and before it is stored: does any `notify` node, at any region depth, name a channel the messaging service knows nothing of? If so, the door answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` and undoes the registration exactly as a refused save does (a create is withdrawn, an update gets the held definition back); nothing is stored.

- The message opens `Flow 'NAME' rejected: N notify channel(s) no plugin registers:`, then one line per finding: node id, `notify`, the region scope when nested, the channel, its path (`nodes.1.config.channels`, `.0` for a list member, `nodes.2.config.body.nodes.0.config.channels.1` inside a loop body), and a did-you-mean (`nearestName`). It ends with the roster: `The channels this deployment registers: inbox, email, sms, push (no transport configured yet).` and the cure. `error.details.fields` carries each path with `code: invalid_value`.
- Channel names are read the way the executor reads them at run time (`toStringList` in `notify-node.ts`: string or list, trimmed, blanks dropped). A node with no `channels` (the inbox default) is not judged.
- Docs: `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` gains the paragraph on the save-time channel check and states that positions and queues are not checked at save (runtime data, resolved when the run reaches the node); `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` gains the same one-sentence statement beside approver resolution.
- Changeset `.changeset/32142-notify-channel-refused-at-save.md`: `@objectstack/runtime` minor, BREAKING accept-set narrowing, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

### Step 0 (the ruling's precondition): the channel registry is complete when the save door reads it

Measured on `origin/main` 3452dec2 (worktree base), before any code was written. The check reads the registry only when all three hold, and each is a platform fact, not an assumption:

1. **The kernel's boot fact.** `ObjectKernel.use()` throws once bootstrap has started (`packages/core/src/kernel.ts`, `Cannot register plugins after bootstrap has started`), so the set of code that can register a channel is fixed at boot. The check runs only when `deps.isRequestKernelReady(context)` is true, i.e. the request kernel's `hasBootPhaseSettled('kernel:ready')`, whose contract reads: every plugin's `start()` and every `kernel:ready` handler has run, so "not published yet" has become "not published". The hono server opens its socket at `kernel:listening`, after every `kernel:ready` and `kernel:bootstrapped` handler (`plugin-hono-server/src/hono-plugin.ts`), so no HTTP save reaches the door earlier on the stock host.
2. **Known, not mounted.** It reads `MessagingService.getKnownChannels()`, which lists the inbox (registered in the messaging plugin's `init()`) and the `email` / `sms` / `push` lazy providers (registered from its own `kernel:ready` handler) whether or not their transport service has arrived. The documented late arrival in `messaging-service.ts` is the TRANSPORT (a service registered after `kernel:ready`), and the provider mechanism exists exactly so it never changes which channel ids exist. A channel whose transport is missing is listed and accepted.
3. **No registry, no verdict.** With no messaging service the notify node is a skipped no-op whatever it names, and a messaging implementation without `getKnownChannels()` cannot be enumerated: neither is judged.

Producers of channels, searched: `git grep 'registerChannel(Provider)?('` on this tree finds only `service-messaging/src/messaging-service-plugin.ts` (inbox, email, sms, push); a code search over the `objectstack-ai` org's indexed repositories finds no other production caller. No `unregisterChannel` caller exists outside tests.

Why the save doors and not `registerFlow`: the boot pull registers a package's flows from the automation plugin's `start()`, before the messaging plugin's `kernel:ready` handler has registered its providers, so a registration check would false-refuse a packaged flow naming `email` at boot; and a stored row re-registered later must keep binding as it did when saved.

The residual the measurement cannot close, stated plainly: `registerChannel` is a public method with no seal, so a third-party plugin that registers a channel only after `kernel:ready` (from a `kernel:listening` handler, a timer, a settings change) would see a flow naming it refused until that registration has happened. No such producer exists in any repository searched, and it is outside the kernel's own publication window (`start()` / `kernel:ready`), which is the window `hasBootPhaseSettled` declares final.

## Tests

<details><summary>Runtime door pins (new top-level describe in the existing harness file)</summary>

`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-authoring-doors-durable.test.ts`, describe `a notify node naming a channel no plugin registers is refused at the save doors (ruling 6810493176, letter B)`, five cases:

- `POST /`: status 400, `error.code` `VALIDATION_FAILED`, message opens with the refusal, names `node 'tell_ops'`, `'emial'`, the path, `did you mean 'email'?`, and the full roster with `push (no transport configured yet)`; `fields` = `nodes.1.config.channels` / `invalid_value`; nothing saved; the create withdrawn.
- `PUT /:name`: 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` at `nodes.1.config.channels.1`; nothing saved; the engine holds the previous definition (identity).
- Region depth: two findings, the second `(in loop 'sweep' body)` at `nodes.2.config.body.nodes.0.config.channels.1`.
- Control: `[' email ', 'push']` (push unconfigured) and `sms` in the body save 200; a node with no `channels` saves 200.
- Not judged: before `kernel:ready` settled, no messaging service, a messaging service with no `getKnownChannels()`: each 200.

File run at head `0b2672f0ba` (after merging `origin/main`, closure rebuilt): `Test Files 1 passed (1) · Tests 16 passed (16)`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood door pin (real composition through bootStack)</summary>

`packages/qa/dogfood/test/flow-node-config-values-at-registration.dogfood.test.ts`, two cases added to the existing describe (same boot): `POST /api/v1/automation` with `channels: ['inbox', 'emial']` answers 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`, message opens with the refusal, names `'emial'` at `nodes.1.config.channels.1`, roster includes `inbox` and `email`; `GET` answers 404. Control `['inbox', 'email']` answers 200 and reads back. Run: `Test Files 1 passed (1) · Tests 10 passed (10)`. This proves the check is live on a real kernel (ready, messaging composed), not skipped.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one per negative pin; run at commit 5cd0275c, each restored to its HEAD blob d692db39 with git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

All through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`; the suite resolves the source under test from `src/`, so no rebuild is involved.

- A1 refusal removed (`if (lines.length === 0) return undefined;` → `return undefined;`, anchor 1→0): `Tests 3 failed | 13 passed (16)`, each `expected 200 to be 400`.
- A2 readiness guard deleted: `Tests 1 failed | 15 passed (16)`, the not-judged case `ready:false ... expected 400 to be 200`.
- A3 known→mounted (`known.filter((entry) => entry.configured)`): `Tests 1 failed | 15 passed (16)`, the control `expected 400 to be 200`.
- A4 the undo on refusal removed: first attempt refused by the tool itself (replacement count did not rise: the replacement was a substring of the anchor), so it never ran; retried with `void 0;` in place of the restore call: `Tests 2 failed | 14 passed (16)`, `expected "vi.fn()" to be called with arguments: [ 'new_flow' ]` and the held-definition identity.

The dogfood pin reads `dist/` and was not part of the ablation reading.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Pin sweep: `git grep` for flows saved through `/automation` with a channel other than `inbox`/`email`/`sms`/`push`, for `not registered` in runtime and dogfood tests, and for `getKnownChannels` consumers outside service-messaging found no existing pin of the old semantics to flip. The runtime harnesses that boot a kernel double without `hasBootPhaseSettled` are, by the readiness guard, not judged and unchanged.
- The metadata save door (`PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/NAME`) does not run this check; its flow structure refusals at save are the subject of #32289 (a lint rule on the runtime authoring gate), the natural carrier for the same channel judgement there.
- `restoreFlowRegistration` on refusal means a refused definition is registered for the span of one request and then undone, the same transient the existing store-refusal and clone-landing refusals already have.
- The check lives in `packages/runtime` (no new dependency: `collectFlowGraphs` from `@objectstack/spec/automation`, `nearestName` from `@objectstack/formula`, both already dependencies); no file in `service-automation`, `service-messaging` or `packages/spec` changed.

## Verification

Local readings are in the os-dev report comment on #32142 (gates with exit codes, the `--ran` reconciliation, `pnpm lint`, the full runtime suite and the full dogfood battery at the final head). Every family CI runs is read from this PR's check-runs.
